verses.ar: وَكَانَ إِلَيَّ كَلَامُ ٱلرَّبِّ قَائِلًا:
verses.kjv: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.web: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.he: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃

verses.ar: «وَأَنْتَ يَا ٱبْنَ آدَمَ، فَهَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ لِأَرْضِ إِسْرَائِيلَ: نِهَايَةٌ! قَدْ جَاءَتِ ٱلنِّهَايَةُ عَلَى زَوَايَا ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْأَرْبَعِ.
verses.kjv: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.web: “You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה לְאַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל קֵ֑ץ בָּ֣א הַקֵּ֔ץ עַל־*אַרְבַּעַת (אַרְבַּ֖ע) כַּנְפֹ֥ות הָאָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: اَلْآنَ ٱلنِّهَايَةُ عَلَيْكِ، وَأُرْسِلُ غَضَبِي عَلَيْكِ، وَأَحْكُمُ عَلَيْكِ كَطُرُقِكِ، وَأَجْلِبُ عَلَيْكِ كُلَّ رَجَاسَاتِكِ.
verses.kjv: Now [is] the end [come] upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
verses.web: Now the end is on you, and I will send my anger on you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
verses.he: עַתָּה֙ הַקֵּ֣ץ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תֹּועֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: فَلَا تَشْفُقُ عَلَيْكِ عَيْنِي، وَلَا أَعْفُو، بَلْ أَجْلِبُ عَلَيْكِ طُرُقَكِ وَتَكُونُ رَجَاسَاتُكِ فِي وَسْطِكِ، فَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’
verses.he: וְלֹא־תָחֹ֥וס עֵינִ֛י עָלַ֖יִךְ וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ול כִּ֣י דְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתֹועֲבֹותַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּתֹוכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ פ

verses.ar: «هَكَذَا قَالَ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّبُّ: شَرٌّ! شَرٌّ وَحِيدٌ هُوَذَا قَدْ أَتَى.
verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
verses.web: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘A disaster! A unique disaster! Behold, it comes.
verses.he: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה רָעָ֛ה אַחַ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִנֵּ֥ה בָאָֽה׃

verses.ar: نِهَايَةٌ قَدْ جَاءَتْ. جَاءَتِ ٱلنِّهَايَةُ. ٱنْتَبَهَتْ إِلَيْكِ. هَا هِيَ قَدْ جَاءَتْ.
verses.kjv: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
verses.web: An end has come. The end has come! It awakes against you. Behold, it comes.
verses.he: קֵ֣ץ בָּ֔א בָּ֥א הַקֵּ֖ץ הֵקִ֣יץ אֵלָ֑יִךְ הִנֵּ֖ה בָּאָֽה׃

verses.ar: ٱنْتَهَى ٱلدَّوْرُ إِلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا ٱلسَّاكِنُ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. بَلَغَ ٱلْوَقْتُ. ٱقْتَرَبَ يَوْمُ ٱضْطِرَابٍ، لَا هُتَافُ ٱلْجِبَالِ.
verses.kjv: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble [is] near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
verses.web: Your doom has come to you, inhabitant of the land! The time has come! The day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting, on the mountains.
verses.he: בָּ֧אָה הַצְּפִירָ֛ה אֵלֶ֖יךָ יֹושֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ בָּ֣א הָעֵ֗ת קָרֹ֛וב הַיֹּ֥ום מְהוּמָ֖ה וְלֹא־הֵ֥ד הָרִֽים׃

verses.ar: اَلْآنَ عَنْ قَرِيبٍ أَصُبُّ رِجْزِي عَلَيْكِ، وَأُتَمِّمُ سَخَطِي عَلَيْكِ، وَأَحْكُمُ عَلَيْكِ كَطُرُقِكِ، وَأَجْلِبُ عَلَيْكِ كُلَّ رَجَاسَاتِكِ.
verses.kjv: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
verses.web: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.
verses.he: עַתָּ֣ה מִקָּרֹ֗וב אֶשְׁפֹּ֤וךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְכִלֵּיתִ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל־תֹּועֲבֹותָֽיִךְ׃

verses.ar: فَلَا تَشْفُقُ عَيْنِي، وَلَا أَعْفُو، بَلْ أَجْلِبُ عَلَيْكِ كَطُرُقِكِ، وَرَجَاسَاتُكِ تَكُونُ فِي وَسْطِكِ، فَتَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ ٱلضَّارِبُ.
verses.kjv: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations [that] are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD that smiteth.
verses.web: My eye won’t spare, neither will I have pity. I will punish you according to your ways. Your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, strike.
verses.he: וְלֹא־תָחֹ֥וס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ול כִּדְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתֹועֲבֹותַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּתֹוכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מַכֶּֽה׃

verses.ar: «هَا هُوَذَا ٱلْيَوْمُ، هَا هُوَذَا قَدْ جَاءَ! دَارَتِ ٱلدَّائِرَةُ. أَزْهَرَتِ ٱلْعَصَا. أَفْرَخَتِ ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءُ.
verses.kjv: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
verses.web: “‘Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has gone out. The rod has blossomed. Pride has budded.
verses.he: הִנֵּ֥ה הַיֹּ֖ום הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֑ה יָֽצְאָה֙ הַצְּפִרָ֔ה צָ֚ץ הַמַּטֶּ֔ה פָּרַ֖ח הַזָּדֹֽון׃

verses.ar: قَامَ ٱلظُّلْمُ إِلَى عَصَا ٱلشَّرِّ. لَا يَبْقَى مِنْهُمْ وَلَا مِنْ ثَرْوَتِهِمْ وَلَا مِنْ ضَجِيجِهِمْ، وَلَا نَوْحٌ عَلَيْهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them [shall remain], nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither [shall there be] wailing for them.
verses.web: Violence has risen up into a rod of wickedness. None of them will remain, nor of their multitude, nor of their wealth. There will be nothing of value among them.
verses.he: הֶחָמָ֥ס ׀ קָ֖ם לְמַטֵּה־רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא־מֵהֶ֞ם וְלֹ֧א מֵהֲמֹונָ֛ם וְלֹ֥א מֶהֱמֵהֶ֖ם וְלֹא־נֹ֥הַּ בָּהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: قَدْ جَاءَ ٱلْوَقْتُ. بَلَغَ ٱلْيَوْمُ. فَلَا يَفْرَحَنَّ ٱلشَّارِي، وَلَا يَحْزَنَنَّ ٱلْبَائِعُ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْغَضَبَ عَلَى كُلِّ جُمْهُورِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath [is] upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.web: The time has come! The day draws near. Don’t let the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is on all its multitude.
verses.he: בָּ֤א הָעֵת֙ הִגִּ֣יעַ הַיֹּ֔ום הַקֹּונֶה֙ אַל־יִשְׂמָ֔ח וְהַמֹּוכֵ֖ר אַל־יִתְאַבָּ֑ל כִּ֥י חָרֹ֖ון אֶל־כָּל־הֲמֹונָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْبَائِعَ لَنْ يَعُودَ إِلَى ٱلْمَبِيعِ، وَإِنْ كَانُوا بَعْدُ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ. لِأَنَّ ٱلرُّؤْيَا عَلَى كُلِّ جُمْهُورِهَا فَلَا يَعُودُ، وَٱلْإِنْسَانُ بِإِثْمِهِ لَا يُشَدِّدُ حَيَاتَهُ.
verses.kjv: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision [is] touching the whole multitude thereof, [which] shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
verses.web: For the seller won’t return to that which is sold, although they are still alive; for the vision concerns the whole multitude of it. None will return. None will strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
verses.he: כִּ֣י הַמֹּוכֵ֗ר אֶל־הַמִּמְכָּר֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְעֹ֥וד בַּחַיִּ֖ים חַיָּתָ֑ם כִּֽי־חָזֹ֤ון אֶל־כָּל־הֲמֹונָהּ֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְאִ֧ישׁ בַּעֲוֹנֹ֛ו חַיָּתֹ֖ו לֹ֥א יִתְחַזָּֽקוּ׃

verses.ar: قَدْ نَفَخُوا فِي ٱلْبُوقِ وَأَعَدُّوا ٱلْكُلَّ، وَلَا ذَاهِبَ إِلَى ٱلْقِتَالِ، لِأَنَّ غَضَبِي عَلَى كُلِّ جُمْهُورِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath [is] upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.web: They have blown the trumpet, and have made all ready; but no one goes to the battle, for my wrath is on all its multitude.
verses.he: תָּקְע֤וּ בַתָּקֹ֙ועַ֙ וְהָכִ֣ין הַכֹּ֔ל וְאֵ֥ין הֹלֵ֖ךְ לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֥י חֲרֹונִ֖י אֶל־כָּל־הֲמֹונָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: «اَلسَّيْفُ مِنْ خَارِجٍ، وَٱلْوَبَأُ وَٱلْجُوعُ مِنْ دَاخِلٍ. ٱلَّذِي هُوَ فِي ٱلْحَقْلِ يَمُوتُ بِٱلسَّيْفِ، وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ فِي ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَأْكُلُهُ ٱلْجُوعُ وَٱلْوَبَأُ.
verses.kjv: The sword [is] without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that [is] in the field shall die with the sword; and he that [is] in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
verses.web: “‘The sword is outside, and the pestilence and the famine within. He who is in the field will die by the sword. He who is in the city will be devoured by famine and pestilence.
verses.he: הַחֶ֣רֶב בַּח֔וּץ וְהַדֶּ֥בֶר וְהָרָעָ֖ב מִבָּ֑יִת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִ֔יר רָעָ֥ב וָדֶ֖בֶר יֹאכֲלֶֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: وَيَنْفَلِتُ مِنْهُمْ مُنْفَلِتُونَ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَحَمَامِ ٱلْأَوْطِئَةِ. كُلُّهُمْ يَهْدِرُونَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى إِثْمِهِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
verses.web: But of those who escape, they will escape and will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, everyone in his iniquity.
verses.he: וּפָֽלְטוּ֙ פְּלִ֣יטֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֣וּ אֶל־הֶהָרִ֗ים כְּיֹונֵ֧י הַגֵּאָיֹ֛ות כֻּלָּ֖ם הֹמֹ֑ות אִ֖ישׁ בַּעֲוֹנֹֽו׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ ٱلْأَيْدِي تَرْتَخِي، وَكُلُّ ٱلرُّكَبِ تَصِيرُ مَاءً.
verses.kjv: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak [as] water.
verses.web: All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
verses.he: כָּל־הַיָּדַ֖יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְכָל־בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תֵּלַ֥כְנָה מָּֽיִם׃

verses.ar: وَيَتَنَطَّقُونَ بِٱلْمَسْحِ وَيَغْشَاهُمْ رُعْبٌ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ ٱلْوُجُوهِ خِزْيٌ، وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ رُؤُوسِهِمْ قَرَعٌ.
verses.kjv: They shall also gird [themselves] with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame [shall be] upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.web: They will also clothe themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them. Shame will be on all faces, and baldness on all their heads.
verses.he: וְחָגְר֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים וְכִסְּתָ֥ה אֹותָ֖ם פַּלָּצ֑וּת וְאֶ֤ל כָּל־פָּנִים֙ בּוּשָׁ֔ה וּבְכָל־רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם קָרְחָֽה׃

verses.ar: يُلْقُونَ فِضَّتَهُمْ فِي ٱلشَّوَارِعِ، وَذَهَبُهُمْ يَكُونُ لِنَجَاسَةٍ. لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ فِضَّتُهُمْ وَذَهَبُهُمْ إِنْقَاذَهُمْ فِي يَوْمِ غَضَبِ ٱلرَّبِّ. لَا يُشْبِعُونَ مِنْهُمَا أَنْفُسَهُمْ، وَلَا يَمْلَأُونَ جَوْفَهُمْ، لِأَنَّهُمَا صَارَا مَعْثَرَةَ إِثْمِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
verses.web: They will cast their silver in the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing. Their silver and their gold won’t be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh’s wrath. They won’t satisfy their souls or fill their bellies; because it has been the stumbling block of their iniquity.
verses.he: כַּסְפָּ֞ם בַּחוּצֹ֣ות יַשְׁלִ֗יכוּ וּזְהָבָם֮ לְנִדָּ֣ה יִֽהְיֶה֒ כַּסְפָּ֨ם וּזְהָבָ֜ם לֹֽא־יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיֹום֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה נַפְשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְשַׂבֵּ֔עוּ וּמֵעֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑אוּ כִּֽי־מִכְשֹׁ֥ול עֲוֹנָ֖ם הָיָֽה׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا بَهْجَةُ زِينَتِهِ فَجَعَلَهَا لِلْكِبْرِيَاءِ. جَعَلُوا فِيهَا أَصْنَامَ مَكْرُهَاتِهِمْ، رَجَاسَاتِهِمْ، لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ جَعَلْتُهَا لَهُمْ نَجَاسَةً.
verses.kjv: ¶ As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations [and] of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
verses.web: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.
verses.he: וּצְבִ֤י עֶדְיֹו֙ לְגָאֹ֣ון שָׂמָ֔הוּ וְצַלְמֵ֧י תֹועֲבֹתָ֛ם שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם עָ֣שׂוּ בֹ֑ו עַל־כֵּ֛ן נְתַתִּ֥יו לָהֶ֖ם לְנִדָּֽה׃

verses.ar: أُسْلِمُهَا إِلَى أَيْدِي ٱلْغُرَبَاءِ لِلنَّهْبِ، وَإِلَى أَشْرَارِ ٱلْأَرْضِ سَلْبًا فَيُنَجِّسُونَهَا.
verses.kjv: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
verses.web: I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a plunder; and they will profane it.
verses.he: וּנְתַתִּ֤יו בְּיַֽד־הַזָּרִים֙ לָבַ֔ז וּלְרִשְׁעֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְשָׁלָ֑ל *וְחִלְּלֻהָ (וְחִלְּלֽוּהוּ)׃

verses.ar: وَأُحَوِّلُ وَجْهِي عَنْهُمْ فَيُنَجِّسُونَ سِرِّي، وَيَدْخُلُهُ ٱلْمُعْتَنِفُونَ وَيُنَجِّسُونَهُ.
verses.kjv: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret [place:] for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
verses.web: I will also turn my face from them, and they will profane my secret place. Robbers will enter into it, and profane it.
verses.he: וַהֲסִבֹּותִ֤י פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְחִלְּל֖וּ אֶת־צְפוּנִ֑י וּבָאוּ־בָ֥הּ פָּרִיצִ֖ים וְחִלְּלֽוּהָ׃ פ

verses.ar: «اِصْنَعِ ٱلسِّلْسِلَةَ لِأَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَدِ ٱمْتَلَأَتْ مِنْ أَحْكَامِ ٱلدَّمِ، وَٱلْمَدِينَةُ ٱمْتَلَأَتْ مِنَ ٱلظُّلْمِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.web: “‘Make chains, for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.he: עֲשֵׂ֖ה הָֽרַתֹּ֑וק כִּ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ מָֽלְאָה֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּמִ֔ים וְהָעִ֖יר מָלְאָ֥ה חָמָֽס׃

verses.ar: فَآتِي بِأَشَرِّ ٱلْأُمَمِ فَيَرِثُونَ بُيُوتَهُمْ، وَأُبِيدُ كِبْرِيَاءَ ٱلْأَشِدَّاءِ فَتَتَنَجَّسُ مَقَادِسُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
verses.web: Therefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses. I will also make the pride of the strong to cease. Their holy places will be profaned.
verses.he: וְהֵֽבֵאתִי֙ רָעֵ֣י גֹויִ֔ם וְיָרְשׁ֖וּ אֶת־בָּֽתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּאֹ֣ון עַזִּ֔ים וְנִחֲל֖וּ מְקַֽדְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: اَلرُّعْبُ آتٍ فَيَطْلُبُونَ ٱلسَّلَامَ وَلَا يَكُونُ.
verses.kjv: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and [there shall be] none.
verses.web: Destruction comes! They will seek peace, and there will be none.
verses.he: קְפָ֖דָה־בָ֑א וּבִקְשׁ֥וּ שָׁלֹ֖ום וָאָֽיִן׃

verses.ar: سَتَأْتِي مُصِيبَةٌ عَلَى مُصِيبَةٍ، وَيَكُونُ خَبَرٌ عَلَى خَبَرٍ، فَيَطْلُبُونَ رُؤْيَا مِنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّ، وَٱلشَّرِيعَةُ تُبَادُ عَنِ ٱلْكَاهِنِ، وَٱلْمَشُورَةُ عَنِ ٱلشُّيُوخِ.
verses.kjv: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
verses.web: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
verses.he: הֹוָ֤ה עַל־הֹוָה֙ תָּבֹ֔וא וּשְׁמֻעָ֥ה אֶל־שְׁמוּעָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה וּבִקְשׁ֤וּ חָזֹון֙ מִנָּבִ֔יא וְתֹורָה֙ תֹּאבַ֣ד מִכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעֵצָ֖ה מִזְּקֵנִֽים׃

verses.ar: ٱلْمَلِكُ يَنُوحُ وَٱلرَّئِيسُ يَلْبَسُ حَيْرَةً، وَأَيْدِي شَعْبِ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَرْجُفُ. كَطَرِيقِهِمْ أَصْنَعُ بِهِمْ، وَكَأَحْكَامِهِمْ أَحْكُمُ عَلَيْهِمْ، فَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ».
verses.kjv: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
verses.web: The king will mourn, and the prince will be clothed with desolation. The hands of the people of the land will be troubled. I will do to them after their way, and according to their own judgments I will judge them. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
verses.he: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יִתְאַבָּ֗ל וְנָשִׂיא֙ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וִידֵ֥י עַם־הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּבָּהַ֑לְנָה מִדַּרְכָּ֞ם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אֹותָם֙ וּבְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֣ם אֶשְׁפְּטֵ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ פ
